provenance.geometry: Mission 16 exact single road surface and outward architecture normals; original geography and canopy, water excluded from casters.
provenance.ambient: 8 cosine hemisphere rays, 4 m range, 0.055 m normal offset; visibility bounded to avoid black creases. Spatial interpolation on unchanged source vertices.
provenance.canopy: Analytic attenuation tied to existing crown instance bounds and tree anchors; separate deciduous/evergreen density, not measured forest irradiance.
provenance.shadow: Exact static triangles spatially grouped in 64 m cells; runtime local sun map, no raw LiDAR.
